newsitem.title: CHINA: Erdos to list 100 mln B shares.
newsitem.headline: Erdos to list 100 mln B shares.

text.p: Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products Co Ltd, the world's biggest cashmere producer, will list 100 million additional B shares on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on May 23, a company statement said on Tuesday.
The shares, issued from May 6 to 8, are priced at 6.88 yuan, equivalent to $0.83, the statement in the Shanghai Securities News said.

After the issue, the company has a total of 436 million shares outstanding, of which 210 million are foreign currency B shares, accounting for 48.17 percent of the total. The remaining 51.83 percent are legal person shares.

Proceeds from the issue will be used to import production equipment, enlarge sources for raw materials and invest in five cashmere makers to increase production capacity, a company prospectus has said.
China Southern Securities Co is the lead underwriter for the issue, it said.
